bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 16" x 16" x 8" are allowed at Forest Hills Stadium, so most small soft-sided bags and purses are fine.
allowed: Soft-sided bags and purses up to 16" x 16" x 8"
Laptops and iPads, if kept in a bag
bagPolicy.note: Bag check is available outside the venue, just past the main gate at Burns and 69th Ave, for $5 per item. Suitcases and large bags must be checked. Tours may add restrictions.

parking.summary: There is no parking at Forest Hills Stadium, including ADA parking. If you need accessible parking, email hospitality@foresthillsstadium.com and staff will try to accommodate the request if space is available.
